stem: Which statement BEST describes how viruses disrupt normal cellular processes to cause disease?

options.label: A
options.text: Viruses use cell machinery to build products the virus needs.

options.label: B
options.text: Viruses release large amounts of energy into the cell, causing increased growth rates.

options.label: C
options.text: Viruses release antibiotics that destroy the cell membrane so more viral particles can be released.

options.label: D
options.text: Viruses block gene expression and prevent host cell DNA replication.
